tool_schemas.name: think
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided `thought` string as a new immutable log entry for the authenticated client and returns the created log record (including its id and timestamps). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `thought` is missing, not a string, or exceeds server limits; UNAUTHORIZED if authentication fails or no valid API key/session is provided when required; and RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds configured per-client usage quotas.

tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of workspaces visible to the calling identity. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks scope to list workspaces.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

slug.description: Optional exact-match filter for workspace slug.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workspace by id. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if no such workspace exists or is not visible to the caller. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if authentication fails.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or performs lifecycle transitions via `status`. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, invalid transitions, or illegal values. Refuses with CONFLICT if attempting to modify a deleted workspace. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

display_name.description: New display name for the workspace.

thought_retention_days.description: Retention window in days; 0 disables retention deletion.

status.description: Lifecycle transition target. Allowed: active->suspended/deleted, suspended->active/deleted; deleted is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key under a workspace and returns the key record plus the one-time `secret` value. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the workspace is not accessible or not in a state that allows key creation. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid inputs.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to create the key under.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration time (UTC, RFC3339). If omitted, key does not expire.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API key and/or performs lifecycle transitions via `status`. Returns the updated key record (never returns the secret). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions (only active->revoked/expired is allowed) or invalid fields. Refuses with CONFLICT if trying to change a revoked/expired key.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

status.description: Lifecycle transition target. Allowed transitions: active->revoked or active->expired.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, effective scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption for the active workspace context. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if authentication fails or no valid credential is provided when required.

api_key.description: Optional API key secret presented for authentication. If provided, must be an active, unexpired key.

metadata.name: Think MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores append-only "thought" logs produced by clients calling the Think MCP Server. The primary workflow is: authenticate a client (optionally by API key), accept a thought string via the think tool, persist it as an immutable log entry, and track basic rate/usage for abuse prevention a
